verdict.rationale: ADK is an open-source framework (google/adk-python) that can run locally via `adk run`, supports local/offline model providers, and docs explicitly note running 'offline or disconnected... with no connection to Google Cloud,' while Cloud Run/Agent Runtime are optional deployment targets, not requirements. missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of fully self-hosted production deployments and explicit guidance on self-managed scaling/observability outside Google Cloud.
